sources.title: EfficientFormer - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The bare EfficientFormer Model transformer outputting raw hidden-states without any specific head on top. This model is a PyTorch nn.Module subclass. Use it as a regular PyTorch Module and refer to the PyTorch documentation for all matter related to general usage and behavior.

sources.title: EfficientFormer - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: EfficientFormer Imagenet classifier and general purpose backbone. EfficientFormer is a vision transformer model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset.

sources.title: EfficientFormer: Vision Transformers at MobileNet Speed
sources.snippet: Vision Transformers (ViT) have shown rapid progress in computer vision tasks, achieving promising results on various benchmarks. However, due to the massive number of parameters and model design, \\textit{e.g.}, attention mechanism, ViT-based models are generally times slower than lightweight convolutional networks.
